# ProDevOpz Technologies

ProDevOpz (ProDevOpz Technologies) is a custom software development company, technology solutions provider, mobile app builder, and artificial intelligence integration engineering agency.

## Flagship Software Products

- EzBill (EZBill / EZ Bill):
  - Description: Business billing, invoicing, inventory tracking, order management, and revenue analytics software suite engineered by ProDevOpz.
  - URL: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in/ezbill
  - App Icon: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in/products/ezbill-app-icon.png

- S1Pro:
  - Description: Automated mobile silent mode and DND profiler app engineered by ProDevOpz. Automatically silences smartphones upon entering added target areas and radius ranges (such as mosques, temples, classrooms, offices, hospitals) and seamlessly restores sound profiles upon exiting. Features zero-drain background geofencing and VIP caller exceptions.
  - URL: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in/s1pro
  - App Icon: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in/products/s1pro-app-icon.png

- SQLite Studio (Free Online SQL Compiler & ER Diagram Visualizer):
  - Description: Free in-browser online SQL compiler and interactive database schema ER diagram visualizer powered by SQLite 3 WebAssembly (WASM). Features 0ms server latency, automatic foreign key relationship diagrams, line-by-line gutter execution, 100% client-side privacy, and 1-click CSV/JSON export.
  - ProDevOpz Showcase: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in/sql-compiler
  - Live Application: https://sqlcompiler.jobsio.in/
  - Studio IDE App: https://sqlcompiler.jobsio.in/app
  - ER Visualizer Feature: https://sqlcompiler.jobsio.in/features/er-diagram-visualizer
  - App Icon: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in/products/sql-compiler-app-icon.jpg

## Primary Services

- Web App Development: Next.js & React platforms engineered for speed, scalability, and 100% Lighthouse audit scores.
- Mobile App Development: Cross-platform Flutter & React Native interfaces with native security and offline synchronization.
- AI Development: Custom LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and intelligent support agents.
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker/Kubernetes container orchestration and automated CI/CD pipelines on AWS, GCP, and Azure.
- Custom Software Engineering: Bespoke software architectures tailored to business workflows.

## Internship Cohorts

ProDevOpz hosts free online technical internships in Web Development, Mobile Development, AI/ML, Cloud DevOps, UI/UX, and Cyber Security. All graduations receive verified MSME/UDYAM and ISO 9001:2015 certified completion certificates along with signed Letters of Recommendation (LOR).
